messages:
mira: Quick heads-up: noticed sync ordering weirdness during today's canary for the rl-gpu-pool.
mira: Argo retried hooks, then prune ran mid-retry, PVCs ended up Terminating longer than usual.
jonathan: can you paste the argocd/server logs or the hook stdout?
mira: paste logs:
```
W 2024-06-21T09:02:14Z hook-runner: retry 1 failed: rpc error: context canceled
I 2024-06-21T09:02:20Z prune-controller: started prune wave for app rl-gpu-pool
E 2024-06-21T09:02:21Z kubeclient: watch closed (401 Unauthorized) reconnecting
```
ash: ah - kubeclient 401s right when prune started. creds rotated yesterday at 02:00 UTC, but cert still valid?
vikram: leader election flip at 09:02:18 (controller-manager pod restarted), leader reclaimed by run-2
mira: effect: hook job pod kept restarting, argocd considered it failed, queued syncs retried; prune removed some temporary resources before retry finished
jonathan: that would explain PV detach flapping and GPU scheduler not seeing capacity -> scale didn't trigger
ash: is this limited to rl-gpu-pool or across regions?
mira: only eu-west cluster for now (weird). us-west seemed fine.
vikram: possible root: kubeclient token TTL + controller restart ordering causing backlog requeue with wrong timestamps
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] sync request queued: apps/rl-gpu-pool (user=mira) retry=2
mira: workaround I'm trying: pause prune for the app, increase hook retry window to 10m, and bump controller kubeclient reauth backoff.
ash: config change snippet:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  resource.customizations.health.argocd: |
    hookRetryWindow: "600s"
  controller.kubeclient.reauthBackoff: "30s"
```
jonathan: if that works we should add postmortem to infra runbook and add probe to detect 401 storms
vikram: also add a reconciliation gate so prune doesn't run while hooks are in flight (or use ordered finalizers)
mira: agreed. filing a short RFC for ordered prune semantics + leader heartbeat smoothing.
mira: ETA on rollback window? need to un-pause before peak traffic at 13:00 UTC.
ash: I'll hold prune and deploy-bot pause set for 12:55 UTC :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] prune paused for apps/rl-gpu-pool until 2024-06-21T12:55:00Z by ash
jonathan: thanks, keep updates here if anything spikes.
